item.title: Victim in Times Square stabbing identified as Bank of America employee
item.description: Erin Piacenti was identified as one of the two people stabbed by a woman Monday afternoon in Times Square before police shot and killed the suspect.

item.title: Pa. police officer charged​ after fatally shooting student at wrong home
item.description: Upper Pottsgrove Police Cpl. Sean Farrell was charged with voluntary manslaughter in the fatal shooting of Glenwood Earl Pysher IV on Aug. 23, officials said.

item.title: Edouard weakens to depression as heavy rain hits southeastern Texas
item.description: Edouard weakened to a tropical depression Tuesday night as wind and heavy rainfall continued to sweep southeastern Texas, the National Hurricane Center said.

item.title: Markey defeats Moulton in Massachusetts' Democratic primary for Senate
item.description: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey has won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts.

item.title: Defense attorney believes jury had "preconceived notions" in Tupac trial
item.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted of first-degree murder nearly 30 years after the drive-by shooting that killed Tupac Shakur.

item.title: Iran launches attacks on Jordan and Bahrain as hostilities flare
item.description: U.S. forces launched new strikes Tuesday on targets connected to Iran's Revolutionary Guard, marking another round of attacks this week as the U.S. and Iran return to hostilities.

item.title: Here are the military officials who've been fired or resigned under Hegseth
item.description: At least 20 generals, admirals and civilian defense leaders have been fired or have departed their jobs since Pete Hegseth became defense secretary at the beginning of the second Trump administration.

item.title: Tiger Woods to change not guilty plea in Florida DUI case, court records show
item.description: Court documents show that Tiger Woods plans to change his not guilty plea in a DUI case stemming from a rollover crash in Florida.

item.title: House votes to condemn socialism, with 8 Democrats joining Republicans
item.description: GOP leaders scheduled the vote after Democratic primary voters embraced a number of democratic socialist candidates.

item.title: Charlie Kirk's alleged killer will stand trial for aggravated murder
item.description: Judge Tony Graf said prosecutors have enough evidence against Tyler Robinson to put the 23-year-old on trial on a charge that could see him face the death penalty.

item.title: Accused Charlie Kirk shooter Tyler Robinson must stand trial, judge rules
item.description: A judge ruled Tuesday that accused Charlie Kirk shooter Tyler Robinson will stand trial in the killing of the late conservative activist, where he could face the death penalty.

item.title: What to expect from new Apple CEO John Ternus as Tim Cook steps down
item.description: John Ternus officially took over for Tim Cook as Apple CEO on Tuesday, becoming the tech giant's first new leader in 15 years. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports and CBS News contributor Patrick McGee breaks down what to expect.

item.title: Duane Davis' attorney doesn't believe jury considered all evidence before Tupac murder conviction
item.description: Michael Sanft, Duane "Keefe D" Davis' defense attorney, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss his client's conviction for the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur and shares his concerns about the jury's "preconceived notions."

item.title: Marine veteran weighs in on Trump's military strategy against Iran as strikes continue
item.description: CBS News contributor Elliot Ackerman, a Marine Corps veteran, breaks down President Trump's military strategy as the U.S. launches new strikes over Iran's alleged interference with the passage of ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides
item.description: The House on Tuesday voted to censure Republican Rep. Chuck Edwards of North Carolina over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides. Edwards denies the allegations.

item.title: Massachusetts Senate primary revolving around age, desire for generational change
item.description: Sen. Ed Markey, 80, is set to face 47-year-old Rep. Seth Moulton in Massachusetts on Tuesday in a Democratic primary for Senate set to be marked by discussions of age and generational change. CBS News' political director Fin Gómez has more.

item.title: Tony Romo pleads no contest to Wisconsin operating while intoxicated charge
item.description: The longtime Dallas Cowboys quarterback and CBS Sports football analyst said he came to rely on alcohol to get off pain medications after multiple back surgeries.

item.title: Officer charged with manslaughter after fatally shooting student who knocked on the wrong door
item.description: A 22-year-old college baseball player was gunned down in Pennsylvania last week after knocking on the wrong door. On Tuesday, a 58-year-old police corporal was charged with manslaughter. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Why Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning now
item.description: U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submitted his resignation Monday after months of friction with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.

item.title: Trump says "biggest attack of them all" is "waiting in the wings" for Iran as U.S. strikes again
item.description: President Trump launched new attacks against Iran Tuesday for allegedly trying to install sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Mr. Trump warned that the worse is still to come if Iran retaliates. CBS News' Natalie Brand has more.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett accuses Texas GOP of wanting to slash poll sites because of high Democratic turnout
item.description: Local officials in Texas are voting on whether to cut the number of polling sites in the state's third-largest county. Officials say it would get rid of low-turnout sites, while Democrats argue it's voter suppression. Democratic Rep. Jasmine Crockett of Texas joins with her perspective.

item.title: New York congressional candidate Brad Lander on being confronted over Israel stance
item.description: Demonstrators confronted New York Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander this weekend over his stance on Israel while he was protesting a Hindu nationalist's appearance at Madison Square Garden. Lander joins "The Takeout" to discuss the incident.

item.title: 9/1: CBS Evening News
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall in Louisiana; the Lindsay Clancy jury told the judge that they are deadlocked.

item.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil could replenish depleted U.S. stockpiles. Will it?
item.description: President Trump framed last week's deal for the U.S. government to take a stake in Venezuelan oil as a boon for the depleted Strategic Petroleum Reserve. But the plan faces some hurdles, experts say.

item.title: State Department spokesman on latest U.S. strikes against Iran, Venezuela oil deal and more
item.description: The U.S. launched new strikes against Iran on Tuesday after tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. State Department Spokesman Tommy Pigott joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: 9/1: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Lindsay Clancy jury unable to reach unanimous decision on Day 4 of deliberations; Trump warns Iran not to retaliate after latest U.S. strike.

item.title: Lionel Richie hospitalized after weekend show
item.description: While performing in St. Louis on Saturday night, Lionel Richie appeared at one point to lean on a piano for support, according to video from the show.

item.title: 2 dead, at least 1 missing after Grand Canyon hit by flash floods
item.description: Violent flash floods hit the Grand Canyon's Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area, causing "extensive damage" to the park's water infrastructure.

item.title: American among thousands missing in Nepal contacted, officials say
item.description: Nepali officials tell CBS News they have contacted a U.S. national among the more than 4,000 people still missing in the wake of the deadly flash floods.

item.title: Woman attacked by otter while swimming in Lake Tahoe, receives nearly 40 stitches
item.description: An open-water swimmer says a routine morning swim in Lake Tahoe turned into a frightening encounter when an otter attacked her underwater.
